case_name: Viklad Coal Merchant, Patiala, Etc v Union of India and Others

statutes.act: Act Being Statutorily Prohibited From Giving Undue Preference By Arbitrarily Picking And Choosing Some Out Of Those Seeking To Use Its Services And Facilities Its Act

holding: The introduction of abbreviation 'GX' and appending it to all railway stations has not resulted in every such station being not open for outward booking of coal, coal shale, lignite etc. in wagon loads and therefore does not violate Sec. 28 of the Act.
The regulatory arrangement helps in smoothly working the Zonal Distribution Scheme and the planned movement of coal.
There is no merit in the submission that the order dated April 1,1972 is violative of Art. 19(1) (g).
